name: magpie-stuck

scripts.check: node scripts/build-page.mjs --check && node --check stuck.hooks.js && node --check page/core.js && node --check page/app.js && node --check page/app.bundle.js && node --check scripts/export-day.mjs && node --check scripts/export-range.mjs && node --check scripts/import-history.mjs
